# Seeds of Renaissance Design System

> The brand and design system for Seeds of Renaissance: feel, voice, colour, type, layout, woodcut graphics, photography, logo, components and whole-page examples, with the CSS to build from. Version 0.1. Every .md link below is raw markdown.

To build something: read BUILD.md first, open the guide for what you are making (website, social and Canva, YouTube, podcast, slides, print, diagrams, email), copy the closest example, use only the tokens and classes in system/, and check against the lists in BUILD.md and the guide. Topic pages hold the detail; you rarely need them for a first draft.

## Start

- [BUILD.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/BUILD.md): start here. Rules in one paragraph, which guide to use for what you are making, rules that apply everywhere, checklist.
- [examples.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/examples.md): every kind of thing we make, its guide, examples and status

## Topics

- [feel.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/feel.md): grounded hope, what we are not, registers, principles
- [voice.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/voice.md): how we sound, key lines, rewrites, calls to action (draft)
- [colour.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/colour.md): grounds, inks, the one accent and the illustration inks for graphics, with roles and rules
- [type.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/type.md): the four faces, the scale, and why
- [layout.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/layout.md): grounds and rhythm, torn edges, grid and spacing
- [graphics.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/graphics.md): woodcut swallow, seal, seeds and clusters, the animal woodcuts (gallery at https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/system/animals/gallery.html), the blue mountains (gallery at https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/system/mountains/gallery.html), and how to use them
- [photography.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/photography.md): what to choose and avoid (all current photos are placeholders)
- [logo.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/logo.md): the chosen logo, colourways, lockups, files and placement; every file shown in logos.html
- [components.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/components.md): every component, when to use it, HTML to copy

## Guides by kind

- [website.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/website.md): web pages: page shell, section menu, checklist
- [social.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/social.md): social media in every shape; Instagram posts done as a Canva kit (examples/social/instagram/)
- [youtube.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/youtube.md): YouTube thumbnails and channel art
- [podcast.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/podcast.md): every podcast image: the episode cover for YouTube (final, Canva kit in examples/youtube/canva-kit/), Instagram episode posts, show art (next); the swallows-and-fingerprints ground
- [slides.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/slides.md): slide decks (brief)
- [print.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/print.md): papers as PDF and posters: covers, anatomy of a paper
- [publishing.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/publishing.md): how we build a paper, PDF and web: design, anatomy, editorial craft, pipeline
- [diagrams.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/diagrams.md): diagrams, figures and charts: type, drawing style, charts, the signature, how to build one as SVG (v0.1); examples at https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/examples/diagrams/index.html
- [email.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/email.md): the newsletter (stub)

## Code

- [system/tokens.css](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/system/tokens.css): every colour, face, size and space
- [system/components.src.css](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/system/components.src.css): components, readable source
- [system/components.css](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/system/components.css): components, built (link this one)

## Optional

- [guide.html](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/guide.html): the whole system rendered on one page (visual; HTML)
- [MAINTAINING.md](https://design.seedsofrenaissance.org/MAINTAINING.md): how this site is built and published
